view: Frontal chest radiograph, AP (probably supine/portable; arms abducted/raised with humeral heads at the top corners, scapulae overlapping the lateral upper lung fields, external tubing lying on the patient)
technical_quality: Suboptimal: low contrast, grainy/noisy with heavy processing; lateral edges cropped and vignetted (dark); scapulae project over the upper lung fields; no significant rotation (medial clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes); adequate inspiration on the left (~8-9 posterior ribs), right hemithorax appears smaller. Skeletal maturity looks adult-type despite the stated age of 10 y. No L/R marker visible - conventional orientation assumed.

devices.type: Chest tube (thoracostomy tube), large-calibre with lumen visible
devices.location: Right hemithorax: enters the lateral right chest wall at the mid zone (about 4th-5th rib level, anterior/mid-axillary line), courses superomedially along the upper lateral chest with the tip at the right lung apex

devices.type: Tube connector / hub (small rectangular radiopaque device)
devices.location: Right lateral chest wall at the chest-tube insertion site, mid zone (patient's right)

devices.type: External drainage tubing with luer-type connectors (two roughly parallel tubes lying on the patient)
devices.location: Overlying the right lower hemithorax and right upper abdomen, lateral to the spine (patient's right)

devices.type: Multiple small linear metallic densities (surgical clips vs metallic foreign bodies)
devices.location: Projected over the left mid zone, medially / perihilar (patient's left)

abnormalities.finding: Hazy increased opacity of the right lower zone with obscured/blunted right costophrenic angle and elevated right hemidiaphragm - pleural effusion (possibly layering on a supine film) and/or right basal atelectasis-consolidation
Diffuse relative haziness and mildly reduced volume of the right hemithorax compared with the left (post-drainage lung, layering effusion or volume loss)
Ill-defined rounded area of increased density adjacent to the right hilum (indeterminate: possible nodule/mass vs overlapping vessels/consolidation) - uncertain
Chest tube tip at the right apex; a small residual apical pneumothorax cannot be excluded - uncertain (no definite visceral pleural line identified)
Multiple small linear metallic densities projecting over the perihilar lung (surgical clips from prior thoracic surgery vs metallic foreign bodies)
Prominent distended gastric air bubble beneath the left hemidiaphragm (incidental)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（疑為仰臥AP攝影，雙臂上舉、肩胛骨重疊於上肺野），影像對比偏低且有雜訊，兩側邊緣遭裁切。右側可見胸管自右側胸壁中肺野處進入，向上內側彎曲，尖端位於右肺尖，插入處有連接頭，右下胸及右上腹外側可見體外引流管線與接頭。右肺整體較左肺混濁且容積略減，右下肺野霧狀密度增加、右側肋膈角模糊、右橫膈升高，考慮右側肋膜積液或右下肺塌陷／實質病變；右中肺野肺門旁有邊界不清之類圓形密度，需與血管重疊區分，右肺尖是否殘留少量氣胸無法確定。左中肺野肺門旁投影數個小型線狀金屬密度影（手術夾或異物）；心臟大小於AP片下未見明顯擴大、縱膈居中，左橫膈下胃泡膨脹，骨骼未見明顯骨折。
